digitalart.title: Digital Art
digitalart.description: A collection of digital paintings and artworks created using various digital techniques and software. These pieces showcase vibrant colors, creative compositions, and imaginative concepts.

render.title: 3D Renders
render.description: Photorealistic and stylized 3D renderings created with advanced modeling and rendering software. These images demonstrate lighting, texture, and material techniques in three-dimensional space.

logo.title: Logo Designs
logo.description: Professional logo designs and brand identity concepts. Each logo represents unique brand stories through typography, symbols, and strategic color choices.

manipulation.title: Photo Manipulation
manipulation.description: Creative photo manipulations that blend multiple images and elements to create surreal and thought-provoking compositions. These pieces push the boundaries of realistic imagery.

vector.title: Vector Art
vector.description: Clean and scalable vector illustrations created using mathematical precision. These designs feature crisp lines, geometric shapes, and bold color palettes suitable for various applications.

illustration.title: Illustrations
illustration.description: A diverse collection of digital illustrations ranging from character designs to environmental scenes. These artworks showcase storytelling through visual narratives and artistic expression.
